subject: Demo environment reliability: on-call + escalation + what counts as a “demo Sev2”
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia_benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 6, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Demo environment reliability: on-call + escalation + what counts as a “demo Sev2”

Team — we’ve had a couple near-misses (and one real miss) where sales was stuck mid-call and didn’t know whether to page, Slack, or just “try reset again”. We need a crisp, GTM-friendly escalation path and a clear definition of “demo Sev2” vs “not a page”.

Proposal (draft; want your edits today so we can publish + train next week):

1) Single entry point for live-demo issues
- Slack channel: #demo-oncall (new) for coordination + status.
- Pager target: “Demo On-Call (SRE)” schedule (alias) for time-sensitive outages.
- SE/AE should NOT DM individual engineers during a live call.

2) What qualifies as “Demo Sev2” (page)
Page SRE (Demo On-Call) if ANY of the below are true AND the issue impacts a live demo or a demo starting within 60 minutes:
A) Demo tenant API returns 5xx > 2% for 5+ minutes OR persistent 401/403 for known-good keys
B) Streaming is broken (disconnects / stuck) in the primary demo region (even if non-streaming works)
C) Model route is unavailable due to capacity / model pin breakage (no safe fallback)
D) Console dashboards/traces are empty AND synthetic traffic job is failing (can’t populate within ~10 minutes)
E) Reset/healthcheck command fails OR takes > 15 minutes to restore a “green” demo state

3) What is NOT a page (handle in-channel or via runbook)
- Single user mis-click / wrong project selected
- Rate limit (429) when demo is running parallel traffic AND workaround exists (drop to backup preset / throttle generator)
- Cosmetic UI bug if core API + Console data still works

4) Response expectations
- Demo Sev2 page: acknowledge < 5 minutes, join #demo-oncall, provide workaround/ETA.
- Non-page: respond in #demo-oncall when available; SE runs runbook steps first.

5) “Backup mode” in live calls (to avoid dead air)
- If not resolved in 3–5 minutes, switch to screenshots/recording for Console + reliability segment.
- Keep API portion live if possible; otherwise use canned outputs.

Open questions:
- Who owns the #demo-oncall rotation on the GTM side (Markus + 1 backup?)
- Should alerts route to #sales as well, or is that too noisy?

If you’re aligned, I’ll publish a short Confluence page + add this to the demo reset runbook.

— Sean
SRE Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia_benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 6, 2026 at 9:26 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo environment reliability: on-call + escalation + what counts as a “demo Sev2”

+1 to this. The failure mode in the field is always “we didn’t want to bother engineering” until it’s too late.

Two asks from sales leadership:
1) Make the definition even simpler for AEs: “If you’re on a live call and the happy path is blocked, post in #demo-oncall and use /page-demo if it’s Sev2.” (or whatever the mechanism is)
2) Alerts should NOT go to #sales. We’ll ignore the noise. We do want a lightweight status page / pinned message in #demo-oncall with current state.

Markus can own GTM triage with an SE backup (happy to nominate one once Markus confirms).

Stephanie

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia_benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 6, 2026 at 9:41 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo environment reliability: on-call + escalation + what counts as a “demo Sev2”

Agree on structure.

A few edits from the “in the moment” perspective:
- Please include an explicit “first 2 minutes” checklist for SEs before paging (otherwise we’ll page on wrong-region / wrong key):
  1) Run demo healthcheck endpoint (or CLI) and paste output into #demo-oncall
  2) Confirm project = demo-* and region = us-west (default)
  3) If Console is empty, run synthetic traffic preset “demo-dashboard-warm” once

- Demo Sev2 threshold on dashboard emptiness: if it’s empty AND the traffic generator job is failing OR ingestion is behind, page. If traffic generator succeeds but graphs lag for 2–3 minutes, don’t page.

- Please add a clause for “capacity/quota”: if we see 429s AND it’s not explained by parallel demo load, that should be Sev2 (we had that exact situation last week).

GTM triage:
- I’ll own #demo-oncall triage during business hours; backup can be Simran Kaur when I’m out. (I’ll align with her separately.)

Markus
Sales Engineering | Demo Technical Owner

From: Allison Grant <allison_grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia_benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 6, 2026 at 10:08 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo environment reliability: on-call + escalation + what counts as a “demo Sev2”

Works for me.

Alert routing suggestion (to keep it clean):
- Alerts post ONLY into #demo-oncall (plus PagerDuty for Sev2 triggers).
- We’ll have 3 alert types:
  1) Demo Sev2 (pages): API error rate, auth failures spike, streaming disconnect rate, model route unavailable, dashboard freshness hard breach.
  2) Demo Sev3 (no page): elevated 429s, dashboard freshness soft breach, synthetic traffic job failed once.
  3) Informational: daily “demo warmup ran OK” + “seed traffic running”.

Also: “ack < 5 minutes” is good. For on-call sanity, we should scope it to business hours first, then expand once we have volume.

If you want, I can draft the actual alert rules + message templates so sales sees consistent text (what happened, what to do now, link to runbook).

Allison
Observability/Alerts

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Allison Grant <allison_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia_benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 6, 2026 at 11:02 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo environment reliability: on-call + escalation + what counts as a “demo Sev2”

+1. Adding one control-plane/auth nuance:

Auth Sev2 should be framed as:
- “Known-good demo key fails with 401/403 across multiple endpoints AND healthcheck confirms the key scope is correct”

Otherwise we’ll accidentally page on:
- expired short-lived token in the demo app
- wrong org/project selected (RBAC looks like 403)

If Markus can paste the healthcheck output in the escalation message, we can triage much faster.

Also please note that resets should not rotate *all* keys by default during business hours — that is a separate (planned) maintenance step. Key rotation mid-day is a common cause of 401/403 confusion.

Ethan
Control Plane / Auth

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia_benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 6, 2026 at 1:47 PM PST
Subject: Re: Demo environment reliability: on-call + escalation + what counts as a “demo Sev2”

Thanks — incorporating edits. Final decisions (so we can move):

A) Channels + owners
- Create #demo-oncall (Slack). Markus owns GTM triage (business hours). Backup: Simran Kaur.
- Alerts go only to #demo-oncall (no #sales).

B) Paging policy (Demo Sev2)
We page “Demo On-Call (SRE)” ONLY when:
1) Live demo is in progress OR starts within 60 minutes, AND
2) Happy path is blocked, AND
3) One of:
   - API: sustained 5xx OR auth failures with known-good key confirmed via healthcheck
   - Streaming: primary demo region streaming disconnect/stall
   - Model: pinned route unavailable w/ no safe fallback
   - Console: empty + traffic generator failing OR ingestion freshness hard breach
   - Reset/healthcheck: cannot get green within 15 minutes
   - Quota/capacity: unexplained 429s (not parallel-demo load) blocking happy path

C) Required escalation payload (paste into #demo-oncall)
- “Live demo? Y/N (start time + customer name if okay internally)”
- Region + project
- Healthcheck output
- Error snippets (request id / trace id if available)
- What steps already tried (reset, traffic warm, backup preset)

D) First 2 minutes checklist (SE)
- Confirm region + project
- Run healthcheck, paste output
- If Console is empty: run traffic preset “demo-dashboard-warm” once

E) Status + training
- Allison will draft alert templates + initial rules.
- Talia: please add this to next week’s enablement session + certification rubric.
- I’ll publish the Confluence page today and link it from the reset runbook.

Publishing links (once live):
- Demo escalation process: https://redwoodinference.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENGSRE/pages/2050783231/Demo+Environment+Escalation+Process
- Demo reset runbook: https://redwoodinference.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENGPLAT/pages/2050062337/Demo+Tenant+Reset+Runbook

— Sean
body: Internal email thread (Feb 6, 2026) establishing a GTM-friendly demo environment escalation process: creation of #demo-oncall, paging criteria for “demo Sev2”, response expectations, required escalation payload, first-2-minutes checklist (healthcheck/region/project verification/traffic warmup), and alert routing approach. Includes edits from Sales (noise avoidance), SE (field workflow), Observability (alert types/templates), and Control Plane (auth nuance; avoid key-rotation mid-day).
